title: Reweave Cremorne
subtitle: Five spaces, five songs. Each one built from the parts of its score — step through and hear which element produced what you are looking at.

panels.title: Reweave Cremorne
panels.blurb: A building deliberately designed to appear out of context, using Brutalism's language of resistance to challenge fast fashion.

panels.title: The Atmosphere
panels.kicker: Radiohead — Everything in Its Right Place
panels.blurb: The ground-floor lobby: melancholy, distortion and electronic intensity as a spatial experience.

panels.title: Common Ground
panels.blurb: The public entrance and common ground: the melancholy of fast fashion as a collective urban experience.

panels.title: The Transition Space
panels.blurb: A moment of pause between the melancholic awareness spaces and the celebratory energy of production.

panels.title: The Kaleidoscope
panels.kicker: Coldplay — Every Teardrop Is a Waterfall
panels.blurb: The sustainable fashion workshop: the song's colourful, playful and uplifting atmosphere as an energetic creative space.
